# apple_builds (Data Source)

Lists the builds that match every given filter, newest upload first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_builds" "testable" {
  app_id            = data.apple_app.example.id
  processing_states = ["VALID"]
  expired           = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Only builds of this app.
- `beta_group_id` (String) Only builds added to this beta group.
- `expired` (Boolean) Only expired builds, or only builds that have not expired.
- `platforms` (Set of String) Platforms to match. Values: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS`, `VISION_OS`.
- `pre_release_versions` (Set of String) Versions to match, e.g. `1.2.0`.
- `processing_states` (Set of String) Processing states to match. Values: `PROCESSING`, `FAILED`, `INVALID`, `VALID`.
- `versions` (Set of String) Build numbers to match.

### Read-Only

- `builds` (Attributes List) The matching builds, newest upload first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--builds))

<a id="nestedatt--builds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `builds`

Read-Only:

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.
- `build_audience_type` (String) `APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE`, or `INTERNAL_ONLY` for builds uploaded as TestFlight Internal Only.
- `expiration_date` (String) When the build stops being testable, in RFC 3339 format.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the build has expired.
- `external_build_state` (String) TestFlight state of the build for external testers, e.g. `READY_FOR_BETA_SUBMISSION`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build.
- `internal_build_state` (String) TestFlight state of the build for internal testers, e.g. `IN_BETA_TESTING`.
- `min_os_version` (String) Minimum OS version the build supports.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the build's version: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `TV_OS` or `VISION_OS`.
- `pre_release_version` (String) Version the build belongs to, e.g. `1.2.0`.
- `processing_state` (String) Processing state: `PROCESSING`, `FAILED`, `INVALID` or `VALID`.
- `uploaded_date` (String) When the build was uploaded, in RFC 3339 format.
- `uses_non_exempt_encryption` (Boolean) The build's export compliance answer; null if unanswered.
- `version` (String) Build number, e.g. `42`.
